html: <sherpa-overlay-panel data-heading="Ada Lovelace" data-icon="person" data-dismissible data-collapsible data-expandable data-floatable>
use: For a quick peek while the page behind stays live: no scrim, no focus trap, and one panel at a time. `data-poppable` lets the reader pop it into a `sherpa-app-shell`'s end panel area as a fixed panel, and out again. `data-floatable` lets the reader float it anywhere in the window, move it by its header and resize it by its corner, and dock it back where it came from. For a fixed panel that stays beside the Context, use a panel area; for a task that blocks the page, use `sherpa-dialog`.
